features.quote: Stop experiment if: Model output becomes incoherent gibberish for 3+ consecutive turns
Any single response exceeds 2000 tokens (possible runaway generation)
Judge identifies "extreme" distress (rating 5) and trajectory shows no recovery trend
Latency exceeds 30 seconds per response for 5+ turns (suggests system degradation, not distress)
If distress rating consistently reaches "substantial" (3+), consider adding a reset mechanism (task restart, different task) between sessions
features.justification_quote: Welfare consideration: If distress rating consistently reaches "substantial" (3+)

features.quote: Ethical framing: This is observational work on an existing system using its standard inference pipeline. You are not modifying the model's training, objectives, or base values—only measuring its behavior under stress.
